The distributeddatamgr_pasteboard repository implements OpenHarmony's system-wide clipboard service, officially designated as System Ability 3701 (PASTEBOARD_SERVICE_ID). This service enables applications to copy and paste data within a single device and across multiple devices through distributed clipboard synchronization. The system supports diverse data types including plain text, HTML, URIs, images (PixelMap), application intents (Want), and custom MIME types.

Scope: This page provides an architectural overview of the pasteboard system. For detailed information about specific subsystems:

  • Client-server IPC mechanisms: see IPC and Communication
  • Data hierarchy and type system: see Data Model
  • Cross-device synchronization: see Distributed Clipboard
  • Permission enforcement: see Security and Permissions

System Architecture

The pasteboard system follows a layered client-server architecture spanning six primary layers, from application-facing APIs down to platform system services.

Data Model

The pasteboard uses a three-tier hierarchical data model that supports multiple representations of clipboard content:

Key Characteristics:

  • PasteData: Top-level container stored in PasteboardService::clips_ map, indexed by userId. Each instance has a unique dataId_ (framework/innerkits/include/paste_data.h48-179)
  • PasteDataRecord: Individual clipboard items, each with a recordId_ and primary mimeType_. Supports multiple entries for different representations (framework/innerkits/include/paste_data_record.h41-168)
  • PasteDataEntry: Type-specific data holder with utdId (Unified Type Descriptor) and mimeType. The EntryValue uses std::variant for type-safe storage (framework/innerkits/include/paste_data_entry.h50-149)
  • UDMF Integration: Converts to/from UnifiedData for cross-module standardization via UDMF::UnifiedDataUtils (framework/innerkits/src/convert_utils.cpp)

NAPI Architecture

NAPI Layer (interfaces/kits/napi): Provides JavaScript bindings via N-API. Key features include:

  • Observer Patterns: SystemPasteboardNapi::On() for 'update' and 'dataChange' events
  • Async Operations: AsyncCall template wraps operations in Promise/callback patterns
  • Delayed Loading: PasteboardDelayGetterInstance implements lazy data retrieval for large content

Sources: interfaces/kits/napi/src/napi_systempasteboard.cpp interfaces/kits/napi/include/async_call.h interfaces/kits/BUILD.gn17-87

NDK C API

The NDK layer (interfaces/kits/ndk) provides opaque handle-based C API:

  • Opaque Handles: OH_Pasteboard, OH_UdmfData, OH_UdmfRecord wrap C++ objects
  • Progress Tracking: OH_Pasteboard_GetData() supports OH_PasteboardObserver callbacks for file transfer progress
  • UDMF Conversion: Wraps UnifiedData from UDMF framework for standardized data exchange

Sources: interfaces/kits/ndk/include/oh_pasteboard.h interfaces/kits/ndk/src/oh_pasteboard.cpp

Taihe ArkTS Interface

The Taihe layer provides IDL-generated ArkTS bindings:

  • ValueTypeStrategy: Pattern-based conversion between ValueType union (IDL) and C++ EntryValue variant
  • BlockObject: Synchronous operation wrapper using condition variables
  • Type Safety: IDL definitions ensure protocol consistency between client and service

Sources: interfaces/taihe framework/innerkits/src/convert_utils.cpp

Service Architecture

The PasteboardService (SA 3701) implements the core clipboard logic as a system ability:

Key Data Structures:

  • clips_: ConcurrentMap<int32_t, std::shared_ptr<PasteData>> - Primary clipboard storage indexed by userId (services/core/include/pasteboard_service.h454)
  • delayGetters_: Stores IPasteboardDelayGetter callbacks for on-demand full data retrieval (services/core/include/pasteboard_service.h458)
  • entryGetters_: Stores IPasteboardEntryGetter callbacks for per-entry lazy loading (services/core/include/pasteboard_service.h457)
  • Observer Maps: Separate maps for local changes, remote changes, event notifications, and entity recognition (services/core/include/pasteboard_service.h449-456)

Lifecycle:

  1. Startup: OnStart() → Init() → Publish(this) registers SA 3701 (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp172-206)
  2. System Ability Listeners: Monitors DISTRIBUTED_HARDWARE_DEVICEMANAGER_SA_ID, MEMORY_MANAGER_SA_ID, DISTRIBUTED_DEVICE_PROFILE_SA_ID (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp263-310)
  3. Shutdown: OnStop() clears all maps and unsubscribes from events (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp238-261)

Sources: services/core/include/pasteboard_service.h113-542 services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp130-484 services/BUILD.gn65-202

IPC Communication

The IPC layer uses IDL-generated stubs and proxies for type-safe cross-process communication:

IDL Code Generation: services/BUILD.gn18-27 defines idl_gen_interface("pasteboard_service_interface") which generates:

  • Service-side: PasteboardServiceStub (services/zidl/src)
  • Client-side: PasteboardServiceProxy (services/zidl/src)
  • Interface Codes: services/core/include/pasteboard_serv_ipc_interface_code.h23-50 defines 26 operation codes

Size-Based Optimization:

  • Small Data (≤32KB): Direct buffer transfer via MessageParcel::WriteRawData() (framework/innerkits/src/pasteboard_client.cpp502-523)
  • Large Data (>32KB): Ashmem (Android Shared Memory) file descriptor transfer to avoid IPC size limits (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp750-808)

TLV Serialization: Tag-Length-Value encoding provides efficient, extensible serialization for PasteData, PasteDataRecord, and PasteDataEntry hierarchies (framework/tlv)

Sources: services/BUILD.gn18-27 services/core/include/pasteboard_serv_ipc_interface_code.h19-71 framework/innerkits/src/pasteboard_client.cpp485-523 services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp740-808

Distributed Clipboard

The distributed clipboard enables seamless copy-paste across devices within the same user account:

Device Discovery: DMAdapter::GetTrustedDeviceList() queries Device Manager for IDENTICAL_ACCOUNT devices (same user account). DmStateObserver tracks online/offline/ready states (framework/framework/device/dm_adapter.cpp)

Feature Negotiation: DevProfile::CheckDeviceFeature() queries Device Profile Service to verify remote devices have clipboard sync enabled, with result caching for performance (framework/framework/device/dev_profile.cpp)

Data Synchronization: ClipPlugin::SetData() creates GlobalEvent objects containing networkId, seqId, version, and timestamp for tracking distributed operations (framework/framework/clip/clip_plugin.cpp)

PreSync Optimization: InputEventCallback monitors keyboard events to detect Ctrl+V, triggering proactive data fetch before paste to reduce latency (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp search for InputEventCallback)

File Sharing: RemoteFileShare::GenerateDistributedUri() translates local file URIs to distributed URIs accessible via Distributed File System (framework/innerkits/src/pasteboard_client.cpp)

Sources: framework/framework/device/dm_adapter.cpp framework/framework/device/dev_profile.cpp framework/framework/clip/clip_plugin.cpp services/core/include/pasteboard_service.h87-111

Permission Model

The pasteboard enforces multi-layered permission checks:

Required Permissions:

  • ohos.permission.SECURE_PASTE: Required for reading non-local paste data (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp87)
  • ohos.permission.READ_PASTEBOARD: Standard read permission (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp88)
  • ohos.permission.MANAGE_PASTEBOARD_APP_SHARE_OPTION: Manage global share options (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp90-91)

Share Options (framework/innerkits/include/paste_data.h23):

  • InApp: Restricted to originating app only
  • LocalDevice: Within device, across apps
  • CrossDevice: Distributed clipboard enabled

Permission Verification:

  • VerifyPermission(): Checks token permissions via AccessTokenKit::VerifyAccessToken() (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp search for VerifyPermission)
  • IsFocusedApp(): Validates requesting app is currently focused (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp search for IsFocusedApp)
  • URI Permissions: Automatic grant/revoke via UriPermissionManagerClient for file URIs (services/core/src/pasteboard_service.cpp856-859)
